title: UI风格#6 - Organic Futurism (有机未来)
description: 创建第6种UI风格：有机未来风格 - 流动曲线、自然渐变、生态感。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planF.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Organic Futurism style When designing Then color palette features soft gradients (greens, blues, teals), organic shapes, flowing curves
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: #2D4A3E Deep Moss, #E8A87C Living Coral, #41EAD4 Bioluminescent Cyan, #FAF6F0 Soft Ivory palette with organic gradients

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Organic Futurism style When typography Then fonts are soft/rounded: maybe Quicksand, Poppins, or similar organic feel
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Playfair Display (serif headers), Nunito (body text), Caveat (handwritten accents)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Organic Futurism style When layout Then asymmetric organic shapes, flowing wave dividers, soft shadows, glass-morphism accents
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: wave SVG dividers, morphing organic shapes, glass-morphism sidebar with blur(20px), soft shadows

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Organic Futurism style When UI elements Then buttons have rounded pill shapes, cards have soft shadows, hover states use subtle scale/glow
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: pill buttons (border-radius: 50px), glass cards, hover scale(1.02) + glow shadow

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Organic Futurism UI When functional Then includes chat interface, agent status, token stats, sidebar navigation
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: full chat UI with messages, 4 agent status cards with organic states, token vitality bars, 5-item sidebar

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Organic Futurism UI When copy Then tagline uses nature-inspired language: 'Grow with AI', 'Flourish', 'Bloom', 'Symbiosis'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'SYMB. GROW. BLOOM.', buttons BLOOM/CULTIVATE/REST/WILT/REBLOOM/NURTURE, status 'Germinating', 'Photosynthesis', 'Blossomed'
